name: smartspace-monorepo
description: SmartSpace & NexusSpace Co-Working Space Management Monorepo

scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm build:frontend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('apps/frontend/.next')) fs.cpSync('apps/frontend/.next', '.next', {recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('apps/frontend/public')) fs.cpSync('apps/frontend/public', 'public', {recursive:true});"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['apps/frontend/.next', '.next'].forEach(p => fs.rmSync(p, {recursive: true, force: true})); console.log('Cleaned Next.js cache successfully.');"
